title: Security review (shared stage)
summary: Static checks that run in every workflow before export and on returned evidence. Never executes project code.

rules: Pattern matches are candidates, never proven vulnerabilities. Clean results are not a security or compliance certification.
teaching_tip: Scanners find patterns, people confirm risk. Treat every finding as a candidate until someone traces it to real impact.
